name: dev.codenation/codenation
title: Codenation
description: Search a hand-reviewed index of developer and SaaS tools, with checked prices and collections.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the Codenation index of developer and SaaS tools. Every word of `query` must match the tool's name, tags, tagline, category or description; results are ranked by relevance. Filter by `category`, `tag` or `pricing`. Returns short records (slug, name, tagline, category, pricing, tags, website, codenation_url) and the total number of matches. Call get_tool with a slug for the full record and checked price. With no query, lists tools alphabetically.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get the full Codenation record of one tool by its slug (as returned by search_tools): description, makers, category, tags, pricing model, website, the collections it belongs to, and when available a checked presentation with what it does, who it suits, the price read on the tool's own pricing page, the date it was read and the source URL. Returns an error result if the slug is unknown.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List every Codenation collection: hand-picked groups of tools that do the same job (for example authentication for SaaS, or privacy-friendly analytics). Returns slug, name, title, description, number of tools, tool slugs and codenation_url. Call get_collection for the tools and their prices.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Get one Codenation collection by slug (as returned by list_collections): its introduction and each tool with a short price and the date that price was checked. Returns an error result if the slug is unknown.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories of the Codenation index with their slug, name, description and number of tools. Use a slug as the category filter of search_tools.

tools.name: submit_tool
tools.description: Submit a project to the Codenation review queue as a free listing. Nothing is published by this call: a person reviews every submission and may decline it. A free listing links to the project with rel="nofollow". Requires the project's name, its full https:// URL and a contact email for the reviewer; tagline, description and category are optional. Only call this when the user explicitly asks to submit a project they are responsible for. Returns the submission id, or an error result if a field is invalid or the site is already listed. Limited to 5 submissions per hour per client.

url.description: Full project URL, starting with https://.

email.description: Contact email for the reviewer. Not published.

tagline.description: One line about what it does. Optional.

description.description: A few sentences about the project. Optional.

category.description: Category slug. Optional, defaults to dev-tools.
